prompt: Write a Python class TaskProcessor that processes tasks from a queue without leaking threads. The class must accept a list of task names in its constructor, and provide a method process_all() that processes each task. The implementation must: (1) create exactly ONE background processing thread at startup that processes all tasks sequentially via a thread-safe queue, (2) never spawn a new thread per task, (3) shut down cleanly when no more tasks remain. Use threading.Thread and queue.Queue. Include proper cleanup in a close() method that signals shutdown and joins the thread.
